description:
Compare banks

One currency at every bank, cheapest to buy first (lowest selling rate), with `meta.cheapestToBuy` (lowest selling) and `meta.bestToSell` (highest buying). Banks with stale rates are listed but not picked. Use when the user asks which bank is cheapest to buy a foreign currency from (lowest selling rate) or best to sell it to (highest buying rate): one call compares every bank.

GET /v1/bank-fx/rates/compare on Bank exchange rates (SBX-BANKFX). Costs 1 credit per call.
name: bank-fx_compareBankRates
title: Bank exchange rates: Compare banks
